//: Composite indexes. Firestore auto-indexes SINGLE fields; any query combining two or more filters needs an entry here or it fails at runtime with 'failed-precondition' and the panel using it stays permanently empty. Every entry below is required by a query that exists in the app today — the file used to be empty while five such queries were live. Deploy with: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes

indexes.//: teacher.js listActiveBans() — the Students tab's active-ban list.
admin.js loadRecentActivity() — recent bans feed on the admin dashboard.
admin.js loadAccessRequests() — the teacher-access approval queue.
student.js submitRentalRequest() — the duplicate-request guard on teachers/{uid}/requests.
